hints.title: Digit Metric Extraction
hints.text: Extract decimal digits using modulo ten arithmetic to calculate both their sum and product.

hints.title: Digit Sum Divisibility Test
hints.text: Verify whether the original integer is evenly divisible by the digit sum.

hints.title: Digit Product Divisibility Test
hints.text: Verify whether the integer is evenly divisible by the digit product when the product is non-zero.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: D: number of decimal digits in n (D <= 10)
complexity.notes: Single pass digit decomposition and constant time modulo operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Number sizes fit comfortably within standard scalar types.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Loop registers avoid string allocation overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle zero products and negative numbers properly.
